findings.summary: Pair character identity with basic appearance to reduce identity/attribute confusion; treat count success separately from binding success.
Danbooru canonical identity and model-specific serialization/trigger surface are separate layers.
Model-specific emphasis sensitivity exists, but exact thresholds remain unpromoted.
Documented count/character/series/artist/special/general/other order supports model-scoped role grouping, not per-tag efficacy claims.
Do not generalize tag effectiveness from one model family/version to another.

tool_impact: Keep canonical tag identity separate from model serialization.
Expose per-character binding groups in future diagnostics.
Retain model/version scope on generation-effect claims.
